{{Quote|Jedi? You mean Padawan Geana? She was with major Panin during the attack. Died in the same blast.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Kollis]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Geana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Assigned to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during [[3642 BBY]], she was protecting [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Panin]] during an Imperial assault on the [[Aurek Base]] and perished in the same blast that claimed his life.
